_comment: The class of every Bitwarden store name for check:ci-bws-pr-path (.ci/rediacc_ci/quality/bws_pr_path.py), per
agent/plans/PLAN-pr-path-ephemeral-credentials.md D7. `pr-safe` names may be fetched by a job that runs on a pull
request; `release-only` names may not, and each carries a reason starting with `BLOCKER:` that passes
rediacc_ci.core.allowlist.validate_reason. Every name in bws-secret-map.json must be classed here, and a classed
name the map lacks is refused as dead. When unsure, a name is release-only: pr-safe is the claim that needs proof.
`baseline.ids` is SHRINK-ONLY: the rule (i) and (iii) findings present when the gate landed, as the first 12 hex of
sha256 over `rule|call chain|name`. A new finding fails and is fixed, never added here; a fixed one fails until
`PYTHONPATH=.ci python3 -m rediacc_ci.quality.bws_pr_path --write-baseline` drains it, and that command only removes.
`--show-baseline` prints the findings the ids stand for.
